tools.name: check_product_stock
tools.description: Check in-stock quantities for a QLP product by color (and size for apparel). Use after search_products when the user asks whether a color/size is available or how many units are in stock. Pass product_id from a prior result (numeric ID or Q-number like Q70797).

product_id.description: QLP product ID — numeric (e.g. 70797) or Q-number string from search_products (e.g. "Q70797").

color.description: Optional color name filter when the user asks about a specific color only.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Fetch structured details for a QLP catalog product: title, body colors, minimum order quantity (MOQ), unit-price brackets, and decoration options (imprint type, locations, setup). Use after search_products when the user asks about a specific product_id / Q-number.

product_id.description: QLP product ID — numeric (e.g. 12345) or Q-number string from search_products (e.g. "Q12345").

tools.name: lookup_order_status
tools.description: Look up order or sample status. AUTH-GATED: never call without proof of ownership. WebMCP (browser): visitor must be signed into the customer portal. OpenAI Ads MCP: portal session_token OR order_number plus ship-to zip. If proof is missing, tell the user to sign in at the customer portal (email/phone one-time code) or — on Ads — provide order number + zip.

order_number.description: Order / sample / PO / quote number (e.g. Z11389432 or a web lead ID).

zip.description: Ship-to zip for guest verification on OpenAI Ads MCP only. Ignored on the public WebMCP remote (use portal sign-in instead — site order lookup uses reCAPTCHA).

session_token.description: Customer portal session token when available (Ads MCP). WebMCP uses the browser portal session automatically and usually omits this.

tools.name: open_live_chat
tools.description: Open the on-site live chat widget so the visitor can talk with QLP support. Use when the user asks to chat, talk to a person, get live help, or continue with a human agent. Browser / WebMCP only.

tools.name: open_product
tools.description: Resolve a catalog product to its absolute product-page URL. Pass product_id and/or path/url from a prior search_products result. Prefer path or url when available; product_id alone is also accepted (numeric ID or Q-number such as Q8). Optionally navigate this browser tab to the product page.

product_id.description: Product ID from search_products (numeric or Q-number string, e.g. 8 or "Q8").

url.description: Absolute or relative product URL from search_products.

navigate.description: If true, navigate this tab to the product page after resolving the URL.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Quality Logo Products promotional catalog by keyword. Use this when the user wants to find products (pens, tumblers, bags, apparel, etc.). Returns matching product titles, Q-numbers, prices, and product page URLs. Optionally navigate the browser to the full search results page.

quantity.description: Desired order quantity for price/MOQ filtering. Only pass when the user stated a number.

budget.description: Total budget in dollars when the user states a spend limit.

color.description: Product body color family filter (e.g. Red, Blue, Black, Camouflage).

brand.description: Brand filter when the user names a brand.

sort_by.description: Sort order for results. Default popularity.

limit.description: Max products to return in the tool response (1-20). Default 8.

navigate.description: If true, navigate this tab to the on-site search results page after searching.

tools.name: start_quote
tools.description: Begin a quote or sample request for a known product_id by resolving the product page URL with the on-site #lead=quote|sample deep-link. Does not create a CRM record by itself — the customer completes the existing form. Optionally navigate this browser tab to quote_url, or open the form in-page when already on that product.

product_id.description: QLP product ID — numeric or Q-number from search_products (e.g. 8 or "Q8").

flow.description: Form type to open. Default quote.

path.description: Optional relative product path from search_products.

url.description: Optional absolute or relative product URL from search_products.

navigate.description: If true, navigate this tab to quote_url (or open the form in-page when already on that product PDP).
